plugin.name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3 Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: Use 0 for the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
ResY.description: Use 0 for the desktop resolution. Set both dimensions to override it.
FixHUD.description: Correct HUD scaling and placement for widescreen while retaining fullscreen overlays.
RandomSongOrderFix.description: Randomize the order of soundtrack songs.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the fix menu language. Auto uses English. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts.
SkipIntro.description: Skip publisher, studio and technology logo movies. Story introductions and other movies remain available. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier on top of widescreen correction. 1.0 preserves the intended framing. Fixed and scripted camera views are excluded.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Single-player score and special meter stay at the left edge, stance icons at the right; centered indicators retain their positions. Auto uses the screen width. A W:H ratio or decimal limits the HUD to a centered box, clamped to 4:3–32:9. Split-screen placement is unchanged.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: 0 preserves the original video aspect with black bars; 1 fills the screen without stretching and crops overflow; 2 stretches to the screen. Applies live during playback.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game window. Released while unfocused, dragging or using system menus. Turning this off releases it immediately.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings to their shipped defaults. Press again to confirm.
menu.restartwarning: Restart the game to apply changed startup settings.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset, then press twice to apply it to this plugin.
